title: Deep Prasad harassed during UAP science work
summary: Deep Prasad tells of Deep Prasad harassed during UAP science work, about recent years at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I I remember you faced some not so fun people kind of messing with you at some point in your UAP science investigation, you know, work where it felt like maybe you hit a nerve among >> some deep stater types or something. Am I wrong about that? >> You are not wrong at all.

plain: Deep Prasad, a researcher who has worked on the science of UAPs (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs), was asked by a podcast host whether unpleasant people had messed with him during that work, as if he had hit a nerve with hidden power players inside government. Prasad answered that the host was not wrong at all, suggesting his research touched something someone wanted left alone.
